items.title: Blog Post Title One
items.body:
It all begins with an idea. Maybe you want to launch a business. Maybe you want to turn a hobby into something more. Or maybe you have a creative project to share with the world. Whatever it is, the way you tell your story online can make all the difference.

Don’t worry about sounding professional. Sound like you. There are over 1.5 billion websites out there, but your story is what’s going to separate this one from the rest. If you read the words back and don’t hear your own voice in your head, that’s a good sign you still have more work to do.

Be clear, be confident and don’t overthink it. The beauty of your story is that it’s going to continue to evolve and your site can evolve with it. Your goal should be to make it feel right for right now. Later will take care of itself. It always does.

items.title: The last blog
items.body:
this trip was truly amazing. i met some of the most awesome fun people- and i never expected it. i feel like the 3 girls i met i've been friends with my whole life. we gave each other shit the whole time- not letting one thing slip. jenna is so sweet and fun (although two people asked if i was her mom, i still love her)! good thing i had her to drink with me every night! sarah is so kool aid! haha she's definitely full of life and will do anything for her friends. lynnette is the unexpected gal. wears a gucci fanny pack but used to fight forest fires. love the sarcasm too! i know i met friends that i will continue to talk to after this is over- we better because we have to all go mountain biking!! i call them my bitches as a term of endearment. :) i can't leave off andy. as the third person in our drinking group, we had too much fun and it wouldn't have been that great without him. he not only watched out for us but made sure we had a good time.
anyways, the trip was an incredible experience and i wouldn't trade it for anything.

items.title: Bintan Indonesia
items.body: yesterday we made it to the 3rd and final country- Indonesia. jenna and i got up early to take the ferry 45 min to Bintan. glad peter recommended bintan instead of Bantam, apparently Bantam is full of hookers and i've seen enough of them this trip. once we got to Bintan we paid (we were suckered) $30 round trip to take a cab from the ferry to a resort- Nirwana Gardens. the resort was pretty cool. white soft beaches, clear blue warm water, a fabulous pool! it was a great end to a fabulous vacation. the only thing that was not fab was the food. jenna had the most disgusting lunch! she ordered the fish. when we got our food she took a bite and had to most horrid look on her face. i said i'll take that as a nasty food face. she's like it smells. only until i got a whiff did i understand- it smelled like sewer. she covered it up asap and then we moved on. for dinner we ordered what we thought were sure things: pasta, salad, potato cuts, and pizza strips. everything but the pizza came and it was good. the waiter dropped off the pizza and it smelled like fish again. i though it was calamari legs so i took a bite- jenna brushed the stuff off. only after my bite did i realize there were little freakin sardines on the pizza with their little eyes looking at me. it was horrible- i thought i was going to puke. the waiter came back and said oh, i guess you ordered too much food? i said no, we didn't know there were sardines on the pizza. he asked, you've never had pizza strips before? like sardines on them are the most common things in the world. i was like apparently i've never had indonesian pizza strips!! nasty!!

items.title: now Indonesia
items.body:
and what a huge change it is from India! i totally appreciated everything about India, but i am glad to be in a city where i don't have to fight with the store owners and can breathe the air without choking. :)
we got in around 7 this morning and spent 6 hours by the pool. i've never been so relaxed in my life- i took about 3 naps today. of course now i have major sunburn to add to my sexy henna legs. i'll have all the boys come a running now. i'm wearing shorts tomorrow, i don't care, i'll never see these people again.
Singapore is one expensive city! we went to a 5 star hotel (Raffles) to check it out and get some drinks- drinks that cost $20. it's funny how we went from one extreme to another. this city is really clean and i totally appreciate it, but it's a big mall so not very exciting. i am looking forward to going to Bintan tomorrow. we're taking a ferry at 9, then it's a 40 min ride to Indonesia. i see beaches and maybe some markets, so we'll see. then it's back to the US! i do have to say i am looking forward to coming home- 3 weeks is a sufficient amount of time to be away and relax.

items.title: I'm not drinking for a while
items.body:
i totally deserve it, but it sux really bad. last night Megha bought some henna paste in a tube and by mistake gave it to me when she was done. needless to say i was quite drunk and thought it would be a good idea to draw all over my legs. none of my pals stopped me- thanks guys! it seems to get getting darker too. this is just in time for the trip to Singapore and Indonesia and the beach. ugh. i'm such a jackass!
we're heading to the airport in a couple hours so i need to start packing. not sure how i'm going to fit everything into my suitcases- then i went and bought for crap today! while the gals dealt with their double charges i went to the shopper's stop (like a macy's) to get my dress. it's amazing how shopping here is so different. you go through a metal detector to get in (although no one ever stops or checks anything). it's not possible to browse without tons of workers coming up to you. they don't usually say anything, they just stare. i smile and they continue to stare. i had several items in my hands, then is dude took them from me, took them off the hangers, then put them in a bag without saying a word. is it not possible to just leave me alone?? then i go to try to the clothes and the lady in the dressing room sets everything up for me. did i mention i have henna crap all over my legs? fabulous.

items.title: A fabulous end to the India trip
items.body:
we had an amazing time today that we didn't expect. we didn't get our sarees until 5 and we had to be at the hotel at 7- it takes an hour to get there. as soon as we got the sarees from the talior we took them straight to the place we bought the fabric- Mysore Silk. if they had a yelp page i would yelp the hell out of them. they are the most amazing people!!
i walked into the store asking the woman for help. she agreed to show us how to do it- i volunteered to be the guinea pig. once the gals saw how difficult it was to wrap a saree, we all shook our heads knowing we would never be able to do it. at that point, the guy who owns the store, Deepak, took all the gals he had working in the shop (all 8 of them) and pointed them to our attention. we had to get the pennicoats that go under the sarees. i didn't want one because i thought i could use my shorts- until the dude asked how i was going to use the loo. i never though of that one. at that point the women have already wrapped my in my saree and i was determined to not use the bathroom all night long if that's what i took so they didn't have to do that again. in the end they ended up getting me one. did i mention that us 4 American ladies totally took over the store and we had 8 ladies helping us? they were the most wonderful people i've met. they started to do my hair. then when they did lynnettes she didn't have enough bobby pins so a girl took one out of her hair and gave it to lynnette. as soon as that happened she started to cry. oh yeah, she started to pour tears. it was the most emotiontial time on this trip. that's right. no child or family in poverty made us cry like we did today. not sure if that's ok, but we were all crying they were so giving and amazing.
when the other gals were getting fitted i asked Deepak what we could do to show our appreciation, money or gifts? he said nothing and almost started to cry- then i wanted to cry. i told him we have to so we're going back tomorrow with gifts for everyone. at one point the gals started doing our hair (girlfriend needs to upload to youtube), and as they were doing lynnett's hair a girl actually took her bobby pin out of her own hair to give it to lynnette. once all of us were fitted we took pic with all the gals. some of the girls were crying. not sure where all the love came from but it was there.
to totally end the whole event, Deepak gave us presents before we left! that's right, he gave all of us individual gifts! he teared up as he gave us them and so did we. who give people a gift? it was the most amazing thing i've experienced. we showed up for dinner looking fab and it was an awesome experince. it was hots as balls but it was totally worth it. if i missed this evening i would be so upset and pissed.
the germans were coming in for a semester from the Alliance school but they we're totally accepting. on their own they are interested, but in a group they act like you're an outcast- the feeling was very odd.

items.title: So everyone remembers the important things in life
items.body:
we all need to wear an eye patch sometime in our lives (but don't forget it causes you to lose your depth perception). it doesn't hurt to do something absolutely outrageous. http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KMj_KWftpBM&feature=related
speaking of great things in life, did you know NIN and Bowie have an album? talk about two great things in life (maybe as good as pb&j?) i've learned so much on this trip!
the sun's out today! did i mention i can't wait to go to the beach? bethie needs some vitamin D. last night i stayed up until 5, drank 1/3 of vodka, slept for 2 hours, then ran for 30 min. do i know how to power through or what? i'll post later after the sari excursion. i'm already annoyed thinking about having tons of faberic drapped across my body trying to eat. that's an accident waiting to happen.
the newspapers out here are awesome; here are some highlights: 'children buried neck-deep in mud to cure them of disabilities', lots of photos of dead people and blood, great commentaries on homosexuality- did you know until recently it was illegal in India?

items.title: Last day of classes and Target visit
items.body:
I am happy classes are over, but that now means i'll have to leave soon :(
we went to Target today. it was finally a good company visit. it's located in a technology park where it's really nice and reminds me of the bay area. this was the first time we've seen nice buildings in Bangalore. we walked in and it was like walking into an American company- finally we were seeing what the companies are like. Target is only in the US and although they don't have plans to expand outside, they have 2K employees in India who do marketing, analytics, etc, same as in the US.
afterwards we went to Ruby Tuesday. OK, go ahead and give me shit again, i deserve it this time. the food was terrible! the artichoke dip was soupy like cream of mushroom, and the chicken mini burgers were nasty. note to self and everyone reading, if you need real American food, only go to Hard Rock- they won't let you down! apparently no one dances here either. this girl Megha said she ready a review about a disco where people were dancing and someone yelled "police!" and everyone sat down really quick- exactly what happened to us last weekend. we went shopping after dinner and were asking people where we could go dancing, they said no where. apparently dancing is frowned upon. i bought more crap tonight. i must stop- i'm not going to fit all my shit in my bags.
tomorrow night is our farewell dinner and all us gals are wearing saris (spelled sarees here). can't wait to have a bunch of material stuck in my pants and falling off- it's going to be very comfortable. we're going to have to party down since it's our last night in India!! not sure how i'm going to dance in a sari, maybe that's why peeps don't dance here. i'll have to figure that one out...
i'm also buying a drawing tomorrow from Mani- that awesome guy we visited last week. looking forward to that. sad thing that we'll probably end back at the Oberoi Hotel and have $20 cocktails just because its so nice there. oh well, only 4 days left of my vaca.
i can't wait to get to Singapore and eat some sushi! after losing weight, i've now gained it back from drinking every night and eating the heavy ass Indian food. i don't know how people live off this stuff, it can't be good for you. the only veggies i've eaten were fried and didn't taste like much. sorry my posts are getting lame- i'll try to get into some shenanigans tomorrow night to keep things interesting- i won't let you down!!

items.title: Got a sari today
items.body:
and no D i didn't see the eclipse :(
it didn't show until 530 am and this was the one night i didn't stay up that late. oh well, i'll hit it up next time. hehe
did i mention i'm over bargaining? i get wait to pay the tag price! i'm so over it i don't even bother anymore- i'm the reason rickshaw drivers are assholes.
we had class and saw another freakin company today. i'm so over school here. at least yesterday we got to pass notes the whole class because the dude was like a grandpa. i turn around once and everyone was on their iphone- that pretty much sums it all up. one more day to go! i'm glad we don't have class anymore but i'm sad because i'm not ready to go back to work.
we have a nice dinner friday so several girls went to get a saree. i wasn't going to but i looked like such a princess in it i had to get one. definitely not the most flattering outfit, but i'll power through. i've made up for all the weight i've lost by drinking. freakin indian food is so heavy- i had no idea. i've never eaten so much naan, grease, and cheese (paneer) in my life. makes me feel a lot better about my diet at home.
i had too much vodka the other night and broke a couple glasses- they have yet to replace them- apparently i'm not trust worthy. we have an awesome rooftop. we stayed up there for a long time the other night. i broke some glasses and did some cartwheels. i also got into a debate with andy from lockheed and told him he works for the devil. he's still angry. i love winning debates.
we got 5 movies for $1 a piece- unfortunately i had to watch Transformers 2. most horrible movie ever. sorry D, your girl is a horrible actress. i know feel dumber after attempting to watch 30 min of it. i can't wait to get to the beach in Singapore and Indonesia!! god knows i need it after this pollution.
going back to the fucking richshaw drivers... the 4 of us gals were haggling with the drivers and we had 2 separate women come up to us and ask us if we needed help dealing with them. that was so nice of them! they wanted to help the 4 Americans. don't see that everyday. every time we get out of one they say we owe them more than we bargained for. fuckers. none of them will turn on the meter either because it's so cheap. $.4 for a ride across town- how do you beat that??!!
i love how everything is so colorful over there. even the garbage trucks have flowers and paintings on them. they aren't tacky either like other certain people who like to paint buildings pink.

items.title: Segregation at the pool
items.body:
that's right, but it's not by race but sex. we went to a local pool to swim and women were only allowed to swim from 3-4! wtf? i've been really surprised at the sexism here. several professors and people from our company visits (including PWC) have made sexist comments. it's funny but sad- we're over it though. no need to argue. after we were denied the pool (since andy was with us) we ended back at the Oberoi Hotel- it's super fabulous. we had some drinks- not sure how i drank yesterday after the night before, but i'm a trooper. it's soo nice there, a great place to get away from the noise and pollution when you need to. never did make it to a pool but we'll head to the beach when we're in Singapore/Indonesia.
other than that yesterday was pretty chill. i needed to rest a bit after only sleeping 2 hours the night before. one thing that was not recommended to bring was a small scarf/handkerchief for those freakin rickshaws. so much pollution in the streets! check out the vid i took from our last ride. 4 of us in one rickshaw- good times. the dude had an amp in the back so we were rockin out. you also get some Beth commentary which is always a good thing: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2Y0mW_x3wcA

items.title: We went to the Hard Rock Cafe
items.body:
and i had the most delicious hamburger in my life! yes, all of you can talk all the shit you want, but i deserved that hamburger. it was the most fulfilling wonderful piece of meat i've ever eaten and i'll do it again as soon as soon as i get the chance :) the freakin rickshaw drivers have no idea where anything is in this city. i have no idea how they function this long not knowing where key locations are. we asked sooo many people where stuff is and they all act like they know- that's what messes you up. you think they know- they don't- so you end up walking in the wrong direction for 30 min. it's not that they are trying to fuck with us- maybe they are trying to be helpful? did i mention how good that burger was???!!
i'm done with bargaining too. i just don't care enough to shop and haggle over each piece. i was about to give up yesterday then lynnette quote a price. he said yes to i got it. i could care less how much i pay anymore, i just want to be done with it! looking forward to get back to the US and pay the price on the tag.
we're thinking about going Indonesia for the day to the beach instead of staying in Singapore for 2 days. it's nice but it's really just a huge shopping mall of a city- and the prices aren't even that good. we only have 2 hours today of lecture thank god. i'm zoning out so much anymore i'm happy as long as i keep my eyes open. need to get ready for class- hopefully we'll be at the pool today! i need some r&r. till then...

items.title: Weekend trip to Belur
items.body:
this trip was so much better than last weekend- probably since we weren't rushing around to get everywhere. saturday morning we took off for the 4.5 hour journey to Belur and it rained the whole day. we saw the Halebeedu temple which was pretty cool- i'm almost templed out though. the resort we stayed at was really nice. since it was raining there were mosquitoes out. of course i haven't taken my malaria pills and my legs got tore up. i have no worries though. at temples you have to take off your shoes- that is not a plesant thing in the rain. sarah and i just walked around under the umbrella trying to dodge puddles- they were gross and warm.
saturday night everyone hung out and drank two bottle of vodka. not sure how i feel totally fine today. there was an awesome tree house behind me and lynnette's room. it was so awesome! we hung out up there most of the night. this was the first time everyone (sans sarah) hung out which was cool- it's usually just me jenna and andy.
the most freak hilarious thing happened this morning before we left the resort. we were hanging out in the room watch Cloverfield (movie about aliens or something). at the end of the movie we heard a loud scratching sound coming from the floor. mind you i woke up this morning thinking monkeys were pounding on the door- not sure who/what was pounding since i didn't want to find out. the four of us looked at each other wondering what the hell that lound scratching sound was. we stared at the floor thinking maybe there was an animal under there- but it was really loud so we started freaking out. all of a sudden, the fucking floor tiles started popping up! that's right! the fucking tiles were popping up then we all screamed like little bitches and ran! hahaha! i though the aliens were coming for us! i threw a huge chair at the floor, lynnette had to hurdle it to get out. we ran up to andy like holy shit dude! we then went back in and determined the moisture caused the floor to contract so the tiles popped up. you can no imagine out hysterically we were laughing. i really thought something was coming for us from the floor- especially after watching that movie.
after that whole ordeal we went to the Shravanabelagola temple. it's on top of a mountain- there are ~600 steps- and there's a huge statue at the top. it was pretty awesome. thank god it didn't rain because i definitely would have seen me busting my ass on all those stairs. there were guys carring up women in chairs (think egyptian) up all those stairs! that's how i want to travel. the view from up there was amazing and so peaceful. along the way i met tons of other visitors and had my picture taken with them. it's so funny how Indians react to a white American girl. they are amazed. so nice and just curious, but they wave and want to take a picture with me. i feel like a superstar :)
only 7 more days in Bangalore...

items.title: Friday- 5 hour spa day
items.body:
spa day only cost me $100 including tip! i got a stone massage for an hour, facial for an hour, pedi and salt scrub! love it here :)
not much else happened today. we had class then went to the spa after- it was only supposed to be for 3 but turned into 5 hours. i think we're going back for round 2 before we leave next saturday. how can you beat that? she did rub the hell out of my boobs with the salt which was not really comfortable.
tomorrow we're going to Belur so you won't hear from me for a couple days. it's a freakin 5-6 hour bus ride! i'm so over these long trips you have no idea. i just want to do my own thing but oh well. hoping to find another fun disco!
we took a "cab" today and i really thought we were going to die. i think the dude was just fucking with us, but it worked. i was so nervous i put my head down and in crash position the whole time. i thought for sure if we weren't going to die a motorcyclist was going to. i was also worried the door was going to open and throw me out. the rickshaws aren't nearly as scary as this dude. i was asking for more excitement and i got it. no more thanks. oh no- stomach ache again, just in time for the long bus ride and weekend away! awesome timing. i hope i'm not nearly as destroyed as i was last weekend- ugh. did i mention i'm eating a costco hotdog as soon as i get home? mark better have it ready for me at the airport.

items.title: Aquarium, park, then disco!
items.body:
we were over shopping (and waiting for everyone else to do something) so some of decided to go to the aquarium. it was hilarious- two floors of small aquariums with crap like goldfish. haha i guess you can't expect all of them to be like Monterrey! we took a rickshaw there and the driver dropped us off where his buddy started following us. it was creepy- he tried talking to us and followed us in the aquarium. i think he just wanted to show us around and get paid, but we ended up loosing him. next to the fabulous aquarium was an awesome park with huge trees- it was so cool! there were bamboo trees and the wind was blowing so they were making loud creeking sounds.
after walking around for a bit we ended up having some cocktails at a bar. it's funny how we order drinks- instead of trying to explain what we want them to make us, we just order vodka and the ingredients and make it ourselves.
then we walked some more and ended up going to a disco. there were people paying to get it but we just walked right in like we owned the place. when we got down the stairs the guys pointed us to the right where the club was. andy checked out what was behind door #2 and it was a strip joint. not sure if they were actually strippers, but he said there was definitely some craziness going on- no other females allowed. so the disco we went to seemed shaddy so we said one drink then we'll bail. after a drink we decided to dance and then everyone was out! it was so much fun dancing! the guys don't touch the females so that's nice to finally go out and not get grabbed. i was dancing with this dude like i was in an Indian movie- it was awesome. the music was Indian dance and awesome. we were singing- not that we knew what we were saying- but that's some good stuff! after we danced for a while- it was about 11 and some yelled police! everyone sat down so fast- can they not dance in India? that was weird so we bailed.
going home was interesting. andy made a deal with the richshaw dude to take us home. eventhough we had a card with the apt's addy- the dude was so lost- and no one we asked could help us with directions. we somehow ended up back here- that's when the driver wanted more $$ than andy bargained for and all hell broke loose. the dude from the apts came out and helped us. seriously $0.2 isn't a big deal, but i guess it's all principal. then we had some more cocktails on top of our roof. the weather is so perfect here! the wind was blowing and it was so peaceful- it's amazing. i love India!

items.title: Whats been going on the past couple days
items.body:
i've been totally slackin on posting so i'll try to make up for it today- but all the days are blurring together. the other day we met one of the Dr's friends, Mani Nagasubramanian- he was awesome! He took fashion merchandising in SD and he's back in India doing architechture and art. His work is really amazing. He did these pieces with a method called forage? (elizabeth help me out here- it's the opposite of a collage). he draws all these lines on paper then scrapes them off. anyways- he's so much fun. we got in his car and he was playing soundtracks to movies like Dirty Dancing and Flashdance, hehe. we had an amazing dinner at one of India's 4 start hotels- seems like all the white people in India are there as well.
Yesterday we went to another company called Featherlite- it's like Ikea. the guy was funny how he has so much money then trys to tell us how they furnished the schools down the road. we stopped to check them out and there wasn't too much there as far as furnishings. then we just came home had some drinks made out of the lemon/oranges and pomegranates we found the other day. we also watch the most horrible movie in the world- Transformers. we got all these movies off this guy down the road. the quality wasn't that bad but the Hangover was actually some crazy Indian movie- suckers! haha
today after class Mani wants to take us shopping for some gold jewelry- i'm not down with the gold but might go just to be treated like a princess for a bit. we made appointments to get massages tomorrow. the lady was like just so you know we do women on women and men on men (because Andy is going with us) i said Andy has no problem with a man rubbing him down with oil. haha
we've been chillin out a lot the last couple of days. we have to go out of town again this weekend. i wish we could make our own travel itineraries!! some of us wanted to got to Mumbai but it's flooded so that's not really an option anymore. once we go out for the evening i'm sure i'll have more interesting posts. i've been laying low on the hard core Indian food- but we'll see how well it mixes with alcohol tonight :) probably not so well. we're used to the noise and crazy traffic now- i don't fear for my life anymore. it's amazing how organized chaos works. how many freakin people like in Bangalore and we've only seen one accident- the peeps in the bay area can't drive for shit. we also saw a guys hanging from a swing looking thing off a roof the other day to wash windows- no netting or anything. why do we so many safety checks and then we still end up injurying and suing all the time in the US?
BTW- i keep getting emails from Mark about getting another dog- does he have it in our place now? will someone please go regulate for me while i'm gone? i can't leave the freakin country for 3 weeks and i end up with more animals...

items.title: Trip to Narayana Hrudayalaya Institute of Cardiac Sciences
items.body: Today we felt some serious heartache. we took a tour of a new hospital here in Bangalore that treats people for heart surgeries. about 1/3 of the patients each week are children. this hospital will treat anyone- the poor are charged $1K for surgery and that money is provided through charities. they have a deal here that farmers pay ~11 cents a month for insurance. since India has such a huge population and not everyone needs surgery, the hospital is able to operate. the guys who founded the hospital is such a visionary it's so moving. makes me feel like i'm an asshole with my job. does working with online games make the world a better place? not so sure.

items.title: First weekend trip to Mysore
items.body:
just got back from Mysore today and the ride back wasn't pleasant. my stomach finally couldn't handle something and things have been rough since friday. we had to make a pit stop and the bathrooms were not good- but i had little choice. thank god for wipes- they didn't have tp, could you imagine??!!
we went for a walk the other night and we saw cockroaches running around. as we're walking Andy goes- do NOT move. of course i freeze in horror since i felt a bug on my neck. then he decides to flick the massive bug off. i was not thrilled. who fucking does that? everyone knows you flick the bug then tell the person. there was a mechanical horse we wanted to ride but the dude said we were too heavy. we told the kid there to ride it and he said he had to sweep the floor. awww
tonight is the first night i'm not consuming alcohol. the other night Sarah asked if she was too much (she's very lively) and Andy said she was the kool-aid man. lol! it's totally true too.
some houses out here have pretty drawings in front- they use rice powder. it's pretty cool. has some coconut juice today- not sure how i've never had it before. it was pretty good! glad it wasn't sweet- i can't handle anymore sweetness. ugh. the desserts here are too sweet. all i want is a costco hotdog!! is that too much to ask?
we're all used to the traffic now but i still haven't taken a rickshaw- that's a must. we were cracking up because they use horns here to lets others know they are there (organized chaos) all the time- it's so loud. we were saying that if we lived here we'd have a bumper sticker that says honk if you love jesus. haha
last night was our adventure in drunkeness in Mysore. we went to this nightclub in our hotel- it was pretty dead except for me jenna and andy, and this other group of peep who are taking yoga classes. they were chill. a french guy told andy that the french like americans now that Obama is our president. haha we smoked out of a hooka, danced, and drank a bottle of vodka. god it's making me sick thinking about it.
saturday we went to a couple temples, the palace (highlight of the day), then to a light show which was weak when you've seen the bellagio one. today we went to the top of the mtn before we left and we saw lots of monkeys! they were awesome.
i'm so tired and dehydrated that i'll have to finish tomorrow- i'm done for the night. peace!

items.title: Day 4- two lectures/Palace Hotel/NASA bar
items.body:
so we had two lectures- the first guy was engaging, but the second dude was nuts! he keep saying "do you understand? yes or no" after EACH sentence. after 2 hours it was very annoying. funny thing is here the teachers will take comments and questions, but they will not really answer you. the second dude kept talking about how India is the way of the future with IT and that we'll be doing online surgeries with patients in the US and Dr's in India- didn't talk at all about the issues why that's really never going to happen. i confronted him on some points but he never did address my question. then it was beer o'clock.
we went to a kick ass hotel- Palace Hotel?? it's a 7 star hotel (they have 7 stars??) and pretty cool. met the best bartender yet. then we hit up the NASA bar. yes it's cheesy but Lynnette works at NASA so we had to hit it up. after heading back around 830 everyone went to bed except me, Andy and Jenna! wtf??!! there are peeps here in their early-mid 20s and they go to bed early every night! are we on vaca or what??
hears some dogs fighting last night which freaked me out- they were yelping and stuff- awww.
the kids are so beautiful! they all just smile and wave. haha they love having their pic taken.
saturday we're off to Mysore- let's hope no one starts any religious riots!! looking forward to the Temple.

items.title: Day three
items.body:
we went to Caterpillar today. they made us fill out a questionnaire to make sure we didn't have swine flu and take our temperature- again! we've had our temperature taken so many times in all countries. in Singapore we walked through a temperature gun, then in India they placed a thermostat on our foreheads. we took a tour of the facilities and we had to wear ear plugs, helmet, eye glasses, and a face mask so we wouldn't give the workers swine flu.
since i woke up at 2 this morning i slept in the van on the way back. the roads are so bumpy that when the van came to a stop my body started twitching- so they tell me.
Sarah almost broke her trachea in the van last night. she was leaning forward and the driver slammed the breaks and she hit her throat on the seat in front of her. hahaha! classic! i'll post a pic with a reenactment- totally worth it.
one of the dudes trying to sell us stuff on the street yesterday pointed to Jenna and then me and fucking asked if i was her mom!! wtf??!! damn that pissed me off. i know i'm old but this girl is like 24 and he thinks i'm her mom? shit
did you know that if you feel the banana from the bottom end it peels so easily??!! that's how monkeys do it. now you know!
now it's 4 and we're drinking Tiger bear. yay!
oh yeah- i drank some local water today and so far so good. we'll see...

items.title: Day two and first day of class
items.body:
we had our first class today. the campus is brand new and beautiful. it's so interesting to see so much poverty then a huge new campus. the class was very interesting and they are treating us so nice! this is definitely the way to travel in India.
we have a van and personal driver that takes us everywhere and waits until we're done shopping- no matter how long. i'm starting to get used to the traffic. it now feels more like a roller coaster than fearing for my life. a guys with us- Andy- went to New Delhi before here and he said this is nothing- so I guess Bangalore is a bit toned down from what the rest of India is like. There haven't been any kids begging for $, only a couple people who have come up to the van. Everyone is so nice and just smile when we walk past or stare out of curiosity.
we went shopping at a market today and i did some bargaining!! i hate bargaining, but my first purchase was a good one. I got 5 Pashina scarfs for an awesome deal- but then i got hosed on a bongo- yes- i bought a bongo. so oh well, i'd rather pay a bit more for something cheap than expensive. everything is so cheap here! i've bought too much already.
i woke up at 2 this morning so i'm not adjusted to the time difference yet- guess i'll have to load up on more drugs tonight to sleep. i've now moved to brushing my teeth totally with the tap water and no issues- even after Indian food for 3 days i'm still ok. i'm sure i won't be for long...
some peeps got tailored suits for $200 each- pretty awesome but i don't wear suits. i have bought a lot of shit so far and week one isn't over yet. i need to slow down- not sure how i'm going to get it all home.
we have an amazing student who goes around with us- Ravuti. she's so nice! she took me to the atm and held my hand as we crossed the street- holding hands for Indians is very common- even for men. it was so cute! she funny to watch her haggle with the vendores- i think i almost have her words down. First- ooo that's too much. second- what's this made out of? third- down the road they sell for __ less.
it was actually cold today. i can't believe how nice the weather is. of course the sun hasn't been out but that's ok with me. it actually feels like CA- i didn't believe some people when they said that! today we're going to Catapiler for school.

items.title: Day one is almost over
items.body:
we had an amazing lunch with the Dr. from the school who has been helping us the whole time. Indian food is so good! now i just have to get mark to like it... that may be challenging. I had tea this morning with ice in it and so far I'm good to go. Maybe I have a stomach of steel?
We said we wanted to go shopping so they took us to the mall- which is like any other American mall unfortunately. Definitely need to hit up the markets later to get the real deal. I hate bargaining though.
I knew they have a caste system here, I'm pretty surprised though how people treat each other in in different castes. It's weird when at home I'm really nice to every one that waits on me- here they don't really treat the servers with much respect.

items.title: It's so not hot in India!
items.body:
everyone can suck it! haha
i'm so surprised how NOT hot it is- I almost need a jacket. the first half day here has been interesting. we took a walk looking for some beer and we didn't find any. the traffic is fucking crazy! they ran across the street, and me trying to be the chill one took my time and ended up in the middle of the street with trucks and cars racing by me. my life flashed before my eyes for a second. the garbage is interesting- not an issue as long as you don't breathe through certain parts. lots of stray dogs and cows.
we saw a dead owl! WTF?? who sees an owl- much less a dead one? haha

items.title: I've been in the same clothes since I left CA
items.body:
Seriously, taking a shower doesn't help much when you have to put on the same clothes. We had an 18 hour layover in Singapore- I didn't realize I wouldn't be getting my checked luggage back since final destination was India. Singapore was really nice. Reminded me of HI. The whole island was pretty much a huge shopping mall. We just rolled into Bangalore tonight at 9, technically I have no idea what time my body thinks it is. Thank god I have pills to sleep or I'd be a mess.
The apts are pretty big- I got one of the bigger ones since I'm older- haha. Nice
So far Bangalore at night seems a lot like Mexico. We'll see what tomorrow has to bring. So far no sickness- but i did wash out my mouth with the water when I was brushing my teeth- I totally forgot.
BTW, it was cold here tonight- we'll see how bearable tomorrow is!

items.title: Where I'm staying
items.body:
Holy crap! It doesn't appear I'm going to be roughing it too much: http://www.maplesuites.in/facilities.html
I was nervous since we're staying in service apartments, but it looks more like a freakin hotel! woot! Can you say daily housekeeping?

items.title: Getting Prepared
items.body:
I have no idea what I'm doing technology-wise. I think I just emailed everyone to look at my blank blog so I'm typing this in. Lots of fun filled blogs to come later when I'm traveling! This is a PG13 blog as I'm sure I'll be swearing a lot. :)
For those of you who don't know I'm leaving July 4th to Bangalore, going to Singapore on July 20th and 21st, then heading back to SFO on the 22nd.
